thread:
Sam (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on wins/losses. Please post one-line why we won, one-line why we lost, and one immediate 30d action we can take. Keep it tight.

Marco (VP Product): Win: customers pick us for predictable tail latency and easy model swaps. Loss: pilot -> private handoff friction. 30d action: publish private quickstart checklist + handoff template.

Leah (Customer Success): Win: white-glove onboarding and clear success plans. Loss: pilot billing surprises and unclear sample invoices. 30d action: publish pilot invoice sample + FAQ and attach to onboarding pack.

Ethan (Sales): Win: demo latency & fallback stories close deals. Loss: RFPs asking for air-gapped install docs and audit artifacts. 30d action: assemble "RFP security packet" (SOC excerpt, KMS notes, network diagram).

Priya (Eng): Win: runtime perf on short-chat workloads. Loss: quantized model regressions on long sequences. 30d action: spec a long-seq perf smoke test; 60d: run spike.

Nina (Solutions): Customers want a single audit bundle to attach to RFPs. 30d action: draft audit bundle skeleton and invite CS/Legal.

Marco (VP Product): Leadership asks owners by EOD tomorrow and a KPI for each (pilot cycle time, RFP conversion for security asks, long-seq p95 latency).

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-9100: "Private quickstart + RFP security packet" assigned to Marco + Nina, due in 30 days.

Leah (Customer Success): @Ethan please DM the 3 recent RFPs that requested air-gap docs so we can attach redacted examples.

Ethan (Sales): Will DM now. Also drafting a 1-page AE rebuttal card for billing and air-gap questions.

Priya (Eng): Tagging eng-runtime & eng-infra for the long-seq spike. Will post a short spec in eng-runtime.

Sam (CEO): Great. Focus on reducing pilot turnaround and RFP friction. If owners hit blockers, escalate to me.

Marco (VP Product): I'll post owners + ticket links here by AM tomorrow. :rocket:
